scope: Independent comprehensive customs research. Directly located targeted source passages ch14–28, NOT exhaustive full-chapter line-by-line review.

summary.ch22_folk_context_note: Harvest mother/doll cases are pre-Christian/comparative folklore as Weiser presents them, not automatically approved Roman Catholic customs

caution: Multiple nested details may be facets of one previous source observation; no automatic identity creation, no endorsement of popular magic or of claimed original rites. Separate Eastern and historical ceremonial descriptions from Roman household practice.
